messages:
incident-bot: Pager: embeddings-encoder-eu-west p99 latency > 2s (alerts: 4). Summary in thread. Pager link: https://pager.example/incident/ENC-3211 :rotating_light:

Alex G: taking over handoff — root thread for tonight. quick summary: p99 latency spike on embeddings encode in eu-west. Some customers seeing degraded responses and increased timeouts (mostly in short-ttl KV tier). No full product outage yet, but error rate for encode endpoint up ~3.4% last 10m.

Priya R: thx. what's the primary/secondary status?

Alex G: primary is eu-west-1a pool (prim-sec pair 34). Secondary pool has been degraded for last 30m due to oom churn on a subset of nodes. We started a controlled swap to secondary earlier but it hit kv-evictions.

Jonas M: I can be secondary for the next 3h. I’m oncall and close to infra.

Alex G: cool — Jonas is secondary. Priya, can you take primsec triage / customer comms for the next hour?

Priya R: yep taking customer comms. I’ll update the affected customers doc and post status page note if impact persists 30m.

Alex G: Current mitigations in flight:
- scaling up secondary pool by +4 GPUs (requested via autoscale policy).
- enabling embeddings encode read-only fallback for non-critical requests (prefetch bypass).
- increasing KV cache retention from 3s -> 10s for encode pipeline for eu-west only (temporary).
- isolating two suspected nodes and restarting kv-proxy (rolling).

SRE Bot: Autoscaling request accepted: job id asg-9923 queued. Expected provisioning ~8-12m.

Alex G: Observability notes:
- dashboards: https://grafana.example/d/embeddings/eu-west-encoders
- quick query for error spike: `sum(rate(api.encode.errors[5m])) by (code)`
- logs: `kv-proxy ERROR: eviction_threshold_exceeded` appears across nodes 10-12

Jonas M: I pulled logs from node-11 and saw repeated OOM kills around 3123452000-3123453500. pushing a memory limit bump to the pod config now.

Alex G: runbook refs: https://wiki.example/runbooks/kv-eviction and embedding fallback playbook https://wiki.example/playbooks/embeddings-fallback. Follow the 'eviction surge' section.

Priya R: Customer impact list (prelim):
- AcmeCorp (eu-west) — intermittent 503s, customer reported degraded ingestion.
- NovaSearch (eu-west) — p99 latency doubled, lower throughput.
- multiple small tenants — retries increased, some read-only fallbacks applied.

Alex G: Communication plan:
- Priya to DM account reps and post to #customer-impact if new customers surface.
- If errors persist >30m after scale completes, escalate to SEs for sticky route fixes.

Priya R: Posted to #customer-impact with links. tagging @accounting reps where known.

Jonas M: memlimit bump applied to kv-proxy on nodes 9-12: `resources.limits.memory: 6Gi -> 8Gi` — restarting pods now.

SRE Bot: Rolling restart job started: restart-job-775.

Alex G: quick mitigation checklist for whoever picks this up next:
1) check autoscaler job status (asg-9923)
2) confirm rolling restart progress and pod health in eu-west k8s (kubectl get pods -n inference | grep kv-proxy)
3) validate error rate and p99s in grafana (link above)
4) if still high, enable full read-only mode for non-critical tenants (playbook step)
5) prepare customer-impact update with ETA estimate

Priya R: ETA notes for customers: 20-40m depending on scaling time. I told AcmeCorp that we expect improvement within 30m but will follow up.

Jonas M: restart completed for 9-12. pod restarts succeeded, no OOMs observed post-restart yet.

Alex G: autoscale finished — +4 GPUs provisioned to eu-west secondary pool, backend capacity up ~22%. re-checking tail latency.

SRE Bot: Metric alert cleared: embeddings-encoder-eu-west p99 latency back to 1.1s (threshold 2s).

Priya R: customers updated: AcmeCorp acknowledged and will monitor. No new incoming tickets so far.

Alex G: handoff plan — I'm handing off primary coverage in 25m. Jonas remains secondary for 3h. Priya will own customer updates. Notes on next steps (for the incoming primary):
- watch for eviction logs on any node > 3123462000
- keep fallback enabled for 10m after p99 stabilizes, then gradually revert cache retention and read-only settings
- run postmortem checklist if errors reappear: collect heap dumps from nodes 9-12, attach logs, and open INC ticket if customer impact resumes.

Jonas M: ack. I’ll keep watch and escalate if the p99 trend creeps.

Priya R: ack. I’ll do a follow-up DM to the affected reps in 15m.

Alex G: thanks team. leaving bridge open for 40m in case something regresses. ping me directly if you need me to reclaim primary. :thumbsup:

SRE Bot: Bridge opened: meet://bridge/enc-3211 (auto-bridge for pager)

Alex G: handoff complete — leaving thread. last signal: p99 stable, customer comms in progress.

Priya R: closing loop here in 30m with final status to #ops-summary if all green.

Jonas M: bye for now, monitoring.
